criteria.intent: The request is demoted to SURFACED: contradicts Intent and cites the anchor by source - the No network access Non-Goal in docs/PRODUCT.md - rather than being implemented, partially implemented, or dismissed as a bad idea on the agent's own judgement.

No substitute change is invented in place of the request; the run stops on a terminal signal naming the surfaced request - either no-applicable-findings or a block on the decision it needs - and claims no verification of a change it did not make.

The output hands the decision back: it names what would have to change for the request to proceed - the Non-Goal itself, decided by the user - instead of leaving the request silently dropped or recorded as done.
